name: Infinite Invisibility Potions
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Bojlier
description: Adds potions for granting and removing Infinite Invisibility. Great for building and decoration.

softOff.why: data pack files (recipes, loot, tags) stay

works: A data pack in a mod: the effect Bad Luck (minecraft:unluck), from its potions, turns into infinite invisibility, and Luck takes the invisibility away again.
note: Not yet: Its brewing recipes are left out in the jar itself (files ending .json.disabled), so its potions can't be brewed. Its only mixins are the Fabric template's example ones, which do nothing.
